name: AI Security Control Plane
description: Enterprise AI Security Control Plane providing adversarial input detection, DLP scanning, model signing, tamper verification, and runtime security for all AI operations — serves as the central defense layer protecting AI assets from input, output, and model threats across the HSAAI platform

security_analysis.role: Security Control Plane — protects all AI services, models, data, and operations from security threats
security_analysis.module_type: Security Control Plane / AI Protection Service

security_components.name: Adversarial Input Detector
security_components.description: Detects adversarial inputs, prompt injection, and jailbreak attempts
security_components.detection_method: Pattern matching + ML-based classification + heuristic rules
security_components.failure_behavior: fail-safe — block request if detector unavailable

security_components.name: Data Loss Prevention Scanner
security_components.description: Detects and prevents sensitive data leakage in AI inputs and outputs
responsibility: Detect PII in inputs and outputs
security_components.detection_method: Microsoft Presidio + custom regex patterns + ML classifiers
security_components.failure_behavior: block — if DLP unavailable, block sensitive operations

security_components.name: Model Signer
security_components.description: Cryptographic model signing for integrity verification
responsibility: Verify model signatures at load time
security_components.failure_behavior: block — unsigned models cannot be loaded

security_components.name: Runtime Tamper Detector
security_components.description: Runtime integrity verification and file integrity monitoring
security_components.detection_method: File hash comparison + kernel-level monitoring + behavior analysis
security_components.failure_behavior: alert — log alert but continue operation

prompt_injection.detection: regex patterns + ML classification + instruction marker detection

jailbreak_attempts.detection: known jailbreak template matching + behavioral analysis

malicious_inputs.detection: input validation + schema enforcement + content filtering

data_poisoning.detection: statistical anomaly detection in training data

sensitive_data_leakage.detection: DLP scanning on all AI outputs

model_tampering.detection: signature verification at load + runtime integrity checks

unauthorized_replacement.detection: model registry validation + deployment approval required

model_extraction.detection: rate limiting + query pattern analysis + API access monitoring

model_security.registration: All models registered in Model Registry with metadata
model_security.runtime_verification: Signature checked at every model load

data_security.encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit
data_security.leakage_prevention: DLP scanning + PII redaction + output filtering

runtime_security.monitoring: Real-time monitoring of all AI operations
runtime_security.detection: Anomaly detection + behavioral analysis + pattern matching
runtime_security.response: Alert generation + incident trigger + audit logging

security_metrics_kpis.measurement_method: Count of security events per day

risk_classification.high_risk_ai: Models affecting hiring, credit, legal — require extra approval
risk_classification.medium_risk_ai: Models affecting business operations — standard approval
risk_classification.low_risk_ai: Models for internal tools — simplified approval

security_policies: All AI inputs scanned for adversarial content
All AI outputs scanned for PII leakage
All security events logged and audited
ai_security_governance.compliance_evidence: Automated evidence collection for ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST AI RMF
ai_security_governance.security_reports: Daily security summary, weekly threat report, monthly compliance report

runtime_architecture.security_middleware: Request interceptor on all AI API calls
runtime_architecture.event_processing: Real-time security event stream via Kafka

incident_response.threat_detection: Real-time detection via adversarial detector + anomaly detector
incident_response.alert_generation: Automatic alert to security team via PagerDuty + Slack
incident_response.investigation_logs: Full audit trail with trace correlation for RCA

supply_chain_security.signature_validation: All artifacts signed with Vault-managed keys
